notes: Official Guest Service Areas page (https://flytulsa.com/travel/amenities/accessibility/guest-service-areas/) read 18 Oct 2026. Quote: "The new Guest Services Areas are located on the lower levels of both Concourse A and Concourse B. Each concourse has the following amenities: Sensory Room ... Lactation Room ... Family Restroom ... Quiet Room The quiet rooms are the perfect place for people with dementia, PTSD or anxiety to take a break if they tend to become overwhelmed by stimulating environments. The quiet rooms have dimmable lighting and relaxing décor." The airport does not describe them as prayer or reflection rooms, so they are listed honestly as quiet seating. Side: the FAQ (https://flytulsa.com/travel/faqs/) contrasts a nursing room 'on the pre-security ticketing level' with the rooms 'on the lower level of Concourse A and B, in the Guest Services Areas', so the concourse rooms are taken as after security; the page does not say 'post-security' in so many words. Hours, wudu, a women's area and qibla marking are not described. No chapel or prayer room is listed: the Accessibility, Programs and FAQ pages were read, and the site's search (which indexes news only) returns nothing for chapel, prayer, meditation or interfaith.
